description.value:
You've trained to strike accurately with powers from far away.

Any power you cast that requires an attack roll has its range doubled.

Your ranged force and tech attacks disregard three-quarters, half, and one-quarter cover.

You also learn one at-will power that requires an attack roll, using Wisdom or Charisma (depending on the power's alignment) if it's a force power, or Intelligence if it's a tech power.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
